gloss: dining and dashing, eating without paying

definitions.gloss: dining and dashing, eating without paying
definitions.explanation: The act of eating at a restaurant and leaving without paying the bill.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{逃|に}げは{犯罪|はんざい}だ。
examples.english: Dining and dashing is a crime.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{逃|に}げをした{客|きゃく}が{警察|けいさつ}に{捕|つか}まった。
examples.english: A customer who dined and dashed was caught by the police.

examples.japanese: {食|く}い{逃|に}げ{防止|ぼうし}のために、{先払|さきばら}いにしている{店|みせ}もある。
examples.english: Some restaurants require payment in advance to prevent dine-and-dash incidents.

notes:
USAGE:
Also used as a する verb: {食|く}い{逃|に}げする. Legally, this is classified as {詐欺罪|さぎざい} (fraud) in Japan.

ETYMOLOGY:
{食|く}う (to eat, informal) + {逃|に}げる (to run away). A compound describing eating then fleeing.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
{飲|の}み{逃|に}げ (drinking and dashing) follows the same pattern. {万引|まんび}き (shoplifting) is a related concept for stealing goods rather than services.
